body: I fixed by setting limit to 8 thusly: https://gist.github.com/p/2d1c26560e63e8850d40

There's a "default limit" in `activemodel/lib/active_model/type/integer.rb`. Comments imply that changing it might cause problems in MySQL or Postgres. Any ideas?

```
# Column storage size in bytes.
# 4 bytes means a MySQL int or Postgres integer as opposed to smallint etc.
DEFAULT_LIMIT = 4
```
Default limit should take into account the column type and the database engine.

issue.title: Should handle the database native out of range error rather than `ensure_in_range`
issue.body:
Actually SQLite3 and MySQL does not need `ensure_in_range`.
Simply should handle the database native out of range error.

Fixes #22594.

issue.title: Avoid `RangeError` without explicit `limit`
issue.body:
Raising `RangeError` was introduced in order to ease to handle out of
range numbers for `find` and `find_by` in postgresql adapter with
prepared statements since #17459. At that time, `Type::Integer` assumed
implicit default byte size is 4 bytes due to `extract_limit` in
postgresql adapter did not extract an integer byte size correctly.
That assumption is harmful for other adapters and caused #22594.
In #26386, it is fixed to register integer types limit correctly.
The handling whether out of range or not is only needed with explicit
`limit`, and `Type::BigInteger` is no longer needed.

Fixes #22594.

issue.title: Register integer types limit correctly for postgresql adapter
issue.body:
currently integer types extracts the `limit` from `sql_type`. But the
lookup key of type map is the `oid` in postgresql adapter. So in most
case `sql_type` is passed to `extract_limit` as `""` and `limit` is
extracted as `nil`.

https://github.com/rails/rails/blob/v5.1.0.beta1/activerecord/lib/active_record/connection_adapters/postgresql_adapter.rb#L445

In mysql2 adapter, `limit` is registered correctly without extracting
from `sql_type`.

https://github.com/rails/rails/blob/v5.1.0.beta1/activerecord/lib/active_record/connection_adapters/abstract_mysql_adapter.rb#L678-L682

Postgresql adapter should also be registered correctly.

``` ruby
  conn = ActiveRecord::Base.connection
  conn.select_all("SELECT 1::smallint, 2::integer, 3::bigint").column_types.map do |name, type|
    [name, type.limit]
  end
```

Before:

``` ruby
  # => [["int2", nil], ["int4", nil], ["int8", nil]]
```

After:

``` ruby
  # => [["int2", 2], ["int4", 4], ["int8", 8]]
```

issue.title: Implicit `DEFAULT_LIMIT` should be 8 bytes (64-bit signed integer)
issue.body:
SQLite integer type is stored in 8 bytes. Assuming as 4 bytes causes
that valid in range value cannot be stored and existing value cannot be
found.

https://www.sqlite.org/datatype3.html

Fixes #22594.
